sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
The game's core gameplay mechanics are straightforward. You'll be presented with a grid of colored cubes, and your objective is to create lines of the same colored cubes, either horizontally or vertically. The game is played on a 6x6 grid, and you can move one cube at a time. You can move a cube to an adjacent empty space, or swap two cubes to create a line.

         The game's scoring system is based on the length of the line you create. The longer the line, the more points you'll score. You'll also score points for creating lines of three or four cubes in a row. The game's goal is to create lines of five or more cubes, which will award you bonus points.

         As you progress through the game, the difficulty level will increase, and the cubes will start to fall at a faster pace. You'll need to think strategically and plan your moves carefully to create lines and score points.
